description: This file provides helper functions, classes, and policies for concurrent queue operations, including bulk push/pop, blocking pop with sleep policies, and queue consumer wrappers.

classes.name: basic_queue_consumer
classes.description: A consumer wrapper for queues that do not expose a consumer API, providing try_pop, try_pop_bulk, and optional blocking pop.

classes.name: queue_sleep_crtp
classes.description: A CRTP base class extending queues with blocking push/pop operations based on sleep policies.

classes.name: sleep_wait_policy
classes.description: Policy class managing sleep intervals and running state for queue blocking operations.

methods.name: try_pop_bulk_generic
methods.description: Attempts to pop multiple elements from a queue in bulk.

methods.name: try_push_bulk_generic
methods.description: Attempts to push multiple elements into a queue in bulk.

methods.name: pop_blocking_generic
methods.description: Blocking pop operation with optional timeout, using sleep policy.
